items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...What are you going to do about George Mraz?

ctx.x: A whole lot of - I've seen piano players that had a one to four. Now you know yourself that you've heard, played with people that were fantastic. Many of your people that you have on your staff at the school, man. I think this man is one of the most fantastic pianists I've heard.

So what are you going to do about people like Niels-Hennings, man? What are you going to do about George Mraz? People that can do it all. Even you yourself, you know. I haven't won the poll since 1960. How many years is that?
